Definition: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed):--and besides, doubtless, at least, yet.
BiblicalUsage: The word gé is and besides, doubtless, at least, yet — a small word, used 19 times; Matthew and Luke show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take gé as it stands — and besides, doubtless, at least, yet — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
